text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working ML engineer with 6 years of experience, and I’d love to help you develop a low-energy 4G IP camera solution that meets your core requirements for remote streaming, IR, recording, remote wake/sleep, 4G and WiFi support, and long battery life.

My background is strongest in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’m comfortable working on practical systems where performance, reliability, and deployment constraints all matter. For this kind of product, I understand that the challenge is not only the camera features themselves, but also balancing connectivity, battery use, and a flexible development path within budget.

In a recent project for Tidewater Outfitters in e-commerce, I built product recommendation systems with similar-items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis. That work led to a 14% increase in click-through rate in a 4-week A/B test. It gave me strong experience in building efficient, production-minded systems that need to respond quickly and scale cleanly.

I also worked with Halvorsen Ceramics on a camera-based crack and chip detector that was exported to ONNX and run on an industrial PC beside the kiln line. That system achieved 97.4% recall on cracks and reduced false rejects from 8% to 2.1%. This project is especially relevant because it involved camera-based processing in a real-world environment where reliability and deployment constraints were important.

For your 4G IP camera project, I can help think through a practical, flexible solution for the software/AI side and support system-level tradeoffs that affect battery usage and remote operation. If you already have an intended hardware direction, I can work with that. If not, I can also help evaluate options based on your feature priorities and budget.

I’m open to discussing the most efficient development path, including sample product work and a phased approach if needed. If you’d like, I can help you define the minimum viable specification first so the project stays focused and cost-effective.
